title: [CRY-8] The routing-envelope signing input is undefined, `id` is circular, and the "ts not authent
description: Review finding CRY-8: The routing-envelope signing input is undefined, `id` is circular, and the "ts not authenticated" claim is wrong (lens CRY). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:181-196, spec/05-messaging.md:204, spec/05-messaging.md:313, spec/10-relays.md:673. Fix: 13:9 says "Agora computes no canonical form", yet 05:206 signs "the routing envelope with `accessSig` omitted", which is a JSON object (05:181-191) with no byte encoding, so no two implementations produce the same input. 05:204 says `billingSig` is "signed per §13.1.1 over the announcement with `billingSig` omitted", but §13.1.1 signs an envelope `body` (13:49, 13:68), and the announcement is not one. `id` is "the CID of the canonical outer envelope" (05:196) while also being a member of it. PoW hashes `envelopeBytes` (10:673) while `powProof` sits inside the envelope. `ts` and `expiryHint` are covered by `accessSig`, so they are authenticated to "some current member", contrary to 05:196 and 05:313. Fix as proposed. It is consistent with D1 ("signatures over exact bytes"): fixed CBOR signing input excluding `id`, `accessSig` and `powProof`; `id` computed over the signed bytes; the announcement as a typed envelope `urn:agora:type:AccessKeyAnnouncement`; corrected `ts`/`expiryHint` sentences. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/05-messaging.md §5.2.2 l217-247 routing envelope is CBOR with `signed` bstr signed by admissionSig over exact bytes; `id` = CID of complete encoded envelope, not carried; ts/expiryHint sentences corrected (l238); announcement/billingSig removed by admission-key decision; spec/10-relays.md §10.5
